text:
maya: Quick sync after usability session: users were confused by the export modal in the rerank flow. issues: ambiguous CTA, preview reads aloud on open, and filename collisions when they download multiple exports. screenshot attached.

drew: saw this too. keyboard focus jumps into the preview table if it auto-expands. SR reads many rows and it's overwhelming.

anita: Accessibility checklist suggestions:
- on open, programmatically focus the dialog heading (tabindex=-1 + focus()) so AT announces the title first
- keep preview content aria-hidden until user explicitly expands it; add a toggle with aria-expanded
- add a short aria-live polite message on open: "Preview collapsed: 15 rows, ~140KB"
- give primary CTA an aria-label like "Start export of 15 items" to add context for AT users

sven: UX/copy picks:
- heading: "Export 15 selected results"
- summary: "CSV (id, text, score). Runs in background; we will notify you when ready."
- CTA: change visible text to "Start export" and add hidden aria-label with count
- preview toggle label: "Show export preview (15 rows, ~140KB)"
- default filename: use pattern `rerank-<collection>-20260323-15rows.csv` to avoid overwrites

olivia: product notes: add checkbox "Email me when export is ready" (checked), retention copy "Download link expires in 7 days", and telemetry: export_opened, export_preview_toggled, export_started (format, count, filename_pattern, notify_opt_in).
build-bot: staging: rerank-export-a11y-fix deployed at commit e1a2b3. please validate keyboard + SR flows.

maya: action items recap: focus heading on open (dev), aria-hidden preview until expand (dev+a11y), aria-live summary (a11y), change CTA to "Start export" + aria-label (design), filename pattern (product/eng), notify checkbox + retention copy (product), telemetry events (eng). I'll file the Figma update and tickets.
drew: +1, I'll own the focus + preview aria-hidden changes.
anita: +1, I'll add NVDA/VoiceOver test cases.
sven: +1, dropping copy variants in Figma by EOD.
